# Sqr <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Sqr:Float32 float:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `float` | In | Float32 | required | A number of 0 or more. |

**Returns:** The square root.

## Description

Returns the square root of a number.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Sqr(2)
Print Sqr(16)
```

```text
1.41421
4.0
```
